evidence.limitations: Gridded product, not a rain gauge; calendar-year sums; high year-to-year variability, no statistically clear trend.
Model-based; part of the warming signal may reflect the data source.

evidence.source: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 via Microsoft Planetary Computer
evidence.resolution: 30 m, mean over the site bounding box
evidence.coverage: 2014-2025, May-Sep scenes with cloud cover under 40%
evidence.limitations: Peak of per-scene means; cloud-masked with QA bands; one 2022 scene skipped (HTTP 403). 2021-2022 values reflect fallow land, not climate.

evidence.source: OpenET Ensemble monthly evapotranspiration (gridMET reference ET)
evidence.resolution: 30 m, single pixel at the site centre
evidence.limitations: Single pixel, not a field average; API returned intermittent errors (retried); 2021-2022 are low because the site was largely fallow.

evidence.resolution: 30 m, pixel counts inside the site polygon
evidence.limitations: Classified satellite product with its own accuracy limits; site is a landscape of about 15 km2, not a single farm field.

evidence.source: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
evidence.coverage: Map units intersecting the site bounding box
evidence.limitations: Top horizon only; component shares are normalised percentages, not area fractions; available water capacity not retrieved; constraints are rule-derived.
